description: Habib Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani sugar producer incorporated as a public limited company in 1962, with its head office in Karachi and its plant at Nawabshah in Sindh — the second sugar mill established in the province. Production began in January 1964, and the company has since added a distillery and a carbon dioxide plant at the same site, organised today into five divisions. It is one of the oldest companies of the Habib group and has been recognised with the Karachi Stock Exchange Trophy and Certificate of Merit and the International Gold Mercury Award.
